    (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) 
    (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) : Filter α :=

    simp [carrier]

  have h2 : ∀ {s t}, s ∈ carrier → s ⊆ t → t ∈ carrier := by
    intro s t hcarrier hsub

    apply hmono tᶜ hcarrier
    exact compl_subset_compl hsub
  have h3 : ∀ {s t}, s ∈ carrier → t ∈ carrier → s ∩ t ∈ carrier := by
    intro s t hcarrier1 hcarrier2

  Filter.mk carrier h1 h2 h3
